name: git-agent-instantiation
description: How to instantiate and task the ephemeral git-agent
steps: ["FETCH AGENT CONFIG: SELECT * FROM agents WHERE name = 'git-agent'", "IDENTIFY PROJECT: Get project_name, project_dir from context or user request", "FETCH PROJECT GIT CONFIG: SELECT git_config FROM projects WHERE name = '{project_name}'", "FETCH GIT SOPS: SELECT name, steps FROM sops WHERE name IN ('git-repo-creation', 'git-commit-conventions')", "BUILD CONTEXT: Combine seed_context files + project git_config + relevant SOPs", "SPAWN AGENT: sessions_spawn(task=\"{context_template}\\n\\nProject Git Config:\\n{git_config}\\n\\nSOPs:\\n{sops}\\n\\nTask: {user_task}\", model=\"claude-sonnet-4\", label=\"git-agent:{project_name}\", cleanup=\"delete\")", "MONITOR: Check sessions_list for completion or use sessions_history to review work"]

name: git-commit-conventions
description: Commit message format and Git workflow conventions
steps: ["FORMAT: Use Conventional Commits - type(scope): description", "TYPES: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, test, chore, build, ci, perf", "SCOPE: Optional - component or area affected (e.g., api, ui, auth)", "DESCRIPTION: Imperative mood, lowercase, no period at end", "BODY: Optional - wrap at 72 chars, explain what and why", "BREAKING: Add BREAKING CHANGE: footer or ! after type for breaking changes", "EXAMPLES: feat(auth): add OAuth2 support | fix: resolve null pointer in parser | docs: update API reference", "PRE-COMMIT: Verify .gitignore includes: node_modules/, .env*, __pycache__/, venv/, build/, dist/, *.log", "IF MISTAKE: Use git rm -r --cached <path> to untrack, then commit the .gitignore fix"]
notes: ⚠️ ALWAYS verify .gitignore before committing! Common mistakes: node_modules/, .env, __pycache__/, venv/, build/, dist/. If accidentally committed, use: git rm -r --cached <dir> to remove from tracking.
